title: Ripp's Inland Charters
specs: Fishing in protected inland waters where guests can see land
Guides born and raised on the bayou with commercial fishing experience
Target species include redfish, flounder, black drum, speckled trout, sheepshead, big blue catfish
Guests must bring a Louisiana charter fishing license
Children age eight and older generally do best; younger children who already fish may also enjoy the trip
Discuss any mobility concerns or special needs before booking
Private charters are the typical experience
Call or text Ripp with preferred date and party size for a quote
includes: Fish cleaning and bagging for fish guests keep
Trip photographs, including an 8 by 10 photo sent to each customer
gap: Exact duration in hours not stated
blurb: Guests take private fishing charters on protected inland waters near Barataria, Louisiana. Trips begin at daylight and usually return around noon. Fishing equipment, bait, life jackets, fish cleaning and bagging, and a knowledgeable guide are provided.
extraNote: Transportation, Louisiana charter fishing licenses, lunch, snacks and drinks are not included · Lodging pickup is available by request and quoted separately · Trips depart from and return to Joe's Landing; lodging pickup available by request · Current rates provided directly by Ripp due to changing operating costs · If weather forces cancellation, deposits are refunded · Call or text Ripp for current charter rate and complete quote · Joe's Landing, across the bayou in Barataria
